findings.note: ADR-0062 now requires a merge commit and rules out squash and rebase. It says both original commits must stay reachable and that the existing historical gate already requires a full-history checkout.
ADR-0062 lists all 8 newly bound paths outside the reference and says any edit to them, including C6 activation, needs a new versioned map.
The 14 manifest cases are labeled as digest-boundary refusals, with a comment saying there is no injectable seam. They no longer claim to cover the inner guards.
A new test runs both mixed old/new states through verifyHistoricalCompatibility and expects GOVERNED_UPGRADE_REFUSED: current bytes.
